pattern: u(1) = u(1) + Kq * (y.q - q0) + Ka * (y.alpha - a0);
replacement: u(1) = u(1) - Kq * (y.q - q0) - Ka * (y.alpha - a0);
rationale: SAS sign flipped (the classic TED/TEU confusion): positive gains then remove short-period damping and stiffness instead of adding them (CONVENTIONS 7).
Wrong measurement: the yaw damper feeds back the roll rate instead of the yaw rate (a wrong field or index into the rate vector).

pattern: in.pb = y.p; in.qb = y.q; in.rb = y.r;
replacement: in.pb = rad2deg(y.p); in.qb = rad2deg(y.q); in.rb = rad2deg(y.r);
rationale: Unit error at the law boundary: the DML declares pb, qb, rb in rad/s, but they are passed in deg/s (as the angles are), multiplying every rate gain by 57.3.
Sensitivity sign reversed (difference taken the wrong way round): the search then steps the gains away from the target, and the reported sensitivities have the wrong sign.
Confirmation step skipped: the search's last assessment (made with the unrounded gains) is reported as the confirmation of the proposed (rounded) gains.

replacement: opts.Controller = @(AC, env, tr) vital.ctrl.pitchSas(AC, env, tr)
rationale: The default no-controller path changed: the factory augments every aircraft by default (a zero-gain SAS), so the M6 bare-airframe results no longer come from the bare airframe.
